ph.title: Packing House
ph.subtitle: From order and receiving to finished goods in storage, waste and the mass balance (milestones M1 and M2). Counts come from the database; every action is checked on the server.
ph.search: Search pallet, arrival or lot code
ph.criticalOpen: {{n}} critical decisions are not decided. Steps that depend on them stay blocked on a real farm.
ph.laterStage: This stage is built in milestone {{milestone}}. There is no sample data here.
ph.wasteNote: Waste follows SOP-WS: QC labels it before anyone weighs it (V-16); the weight decides the sign-off route (V-17) once OD-11 is decided; the creator, labeller and weigher never sign it (SoD-03).
ph.photoStorageNote: Photos are stored in the database (max 5 MB each) until file storage is set up (VR-S01).
ph.noActions: No actions are available for you on this pallet now.

empty.jobCards: No Job Cards at this stage.
empty.fgPallets: No finished pallets waiting for the QC stamp or storage.

plausibility.pending: Not checked: plausibility tolerance pending OD-29
plausibility.confirmed: Outside tolerance; confirmed by the registrar

laterWhy.orders: Order lines are entered by Sales and accepted by PH management.
laterWhy.production: Job cards, line checks and grading (ST-08) are built in M2.

laterWhy.fg_pallets: Finished-goods pallets (ST-10) are built in M2.
laterWhy.fg_storage: Finished-goods storage (ST-12) is built in M3.
laterWhy.dispatch: Loading and dispatch (ST-13, ST-14) are built in M3.

label.title: Incoming pallet
label.noBarcode: Barcode format pending OD-20; the code above is the identifier.
label.noPrintHere: This demo page cannot open the print dialog. The label print is recorded; print from the standalone file or the server version.

forms.vehicleFailHint: A failed vehicle holds the arrival until PHM, QA and top management sign the exception (SOP-TR, E-02).
forms.exceptionHint: PHM, QA and top management must each approve. One refusal ends the arrival as not accepted and the load is returned.

precool.scan: Scan or type a pallet code
precool.scanHint: A scanner that types into this field works; camera scanning is not built.

forms.photosHint: Photos are compressed on this device before upload.
forms.confirmPlausibility: I confirm this weight is correct
forms.weighingNote: Weigh on a scale with a known calibration. Plausibility tolerance is pending OD-29.
forms.lateHint: Arrivals after the documented last receipt time need a reason (E-02).
forms.noneAwaitingCheck: No pallets of this arrival await an arrival check.
forms.noToleranceNotice: No product tolerance is set (pending OD-15). The decision is recorded as a judgement and flagged for QAM review.
forms.recheckHint: Re-check after regrade and re-weigh. A second rejection raises E-04.
forms.overrideHint: This location is not in the pallet's storage group. Moving here is an override that needs a reason.
forms.qc1Notice: QC-1 releases stored pallets to production (G4). It depends on OD-17.
forms.holdTypeHint: Food-safety holds are decided by QAM.
forms.labelHint: Print on A6 or a label printer; the printer model is not yet verified.

reasons.afterQa: This can no longer be changed after QA acceptance.
reasons.blocked_open: Blocked: open decision {{decision}} has not been decided by management.
reasons.blocked_otherOption: Decision {{decision}} chose option {{selected}}, which is not built yet (built: {{implemented}}).
reasons.boxes: Box count must be a whole number greater than zero.
reasons.calibration: Scale {{scale}} has no confirmed calibration; the weight is flagged.
reasons.cell_notOwner: Only the record-type owner may approve this cell ({{owners}}).
reasons.decision_noOwner: Decision {{decision}} has no owner role in the source; it cannot be recorded until one is named.
reasons.decision_notOwner: Decision {{decision}} is signed by its owners: {{owners}}.
reasons.denied_noRole: None of your roles may do this: {{action}}. Roles in the matrix: {{roles}}.
reasons.denied_proposed: {{action}} for {{role}} is only proposed. The record-type owner ({{owners}}) must approve it first.
reasons.fileSize: The file is larger than 5 MB.
reasons.fileType: Only photos (JPEG, PNG, WebP) are accepted.
reasons.g1_notPassed: The arrival has not passed the gate (status: {{status}}).
reasons.g1_vehicle: The vehicle inspection must pass, or its exception be approved, before the gate.
reasons.g2_destination: Pallet {{pallet}}: choose where the rejected product goes.
reasons.g2_notPassed: Pallet {{pallet}} has not passed the arrival check (G2).
reasons.g4_state: Only stored, accepted pallets can be released at QC-1.
reasons.groupChangeReason: {{pallets}} pallets are in this location; changing its group needs a reason.
reasons.hold_dispositionLater: Disposition "{{disposition}}" is built in a later milestone.
reasons.hold_state: Pallet {{pallet}} cannot be held in status {{status}}.
reasons.hold_typeRole: Food-safety holds are decided by QAM.
reasons.later: This step is built in milestone {{milestone}}.
reasons.move_purpose: Pallets cannot be stored in a {{purpose}} location.
reasons.move_state: A pallet in status {{status}} cannot be moved.
reasons.notApproved: {{record}} is not approved master data yet.
reasons.rma_mixed: All pallets in one QA decision must be awaiting QA.
reasons.sod: Segregation of duties: the {{column}} cannot also do this step.
reasons.v02: Net weight must be greater than zero.
reasons.v03: After the last receipt time ({{cutoff}}) a late reason is required.
reasons.v04: Pre-cooling dwell {{minutes}} min exceeds the documented {{max}} min (E-05).
reasons.v07: {{location}} is not in this pallet's storage group; PHM override with a reason is needed.
reasons.v21: Weight differs from the documented nominal ({{nominal}} kg). The tolerance is pending OD-29; confirm the weight.
reasons.v23: A rejection needs at least one photo (V-23).
reasons.v26: Re-weigh is required after regrade before the re-check.
reasons.voidAfterCheck: A pallet can be voided only before its arrival check.
reasons.jc_lineRoute: Line {{line}} is not allowed for this crop (allowed: {{allowed}}).
reasons.v10: The grade must be Premium, GR1 or GR2 (V-10).
reasons.jc_state: Not possible while the Job Card is "{{status}}".
reasons.jc_cancelInputs: Only a draft or planned Job Card with no pallets issued can be cancelled.
reasons.v05: Pallet {{pallet}} is "{{status}}": only pallets released by QC-1 can be issued (V-05).
reasons.jc_crop: Pallet {{pallet}} is a different crop from the Job Card.
reasons.jc_alreadyIssued: Pallet {{pallet}} is already issued to this Job Card.
reasons.jc_issueKg: Issue more than 0 and at most {{available}} kg.
reasons.jc_needInputs: Issue at least one released pallet first.
reasons.jc_needPackaging: The store keeper has not issued packaging yet.
reasons.jc_closeAll: Every issued pallet needs its consumed and returned kg.
reasons.jc_closeBalance: Consumed + returned must equal the {{issued}} kg issued.
reasons.g5_notPassed: There is no passed line-start check to confirm.
reasons.g5_pair: The line-start check is QC and Line Leader together: the confirming person must hold the other role.
reasons.g6_notPassed: QC-2 final inspection has not passed for {{job_card}} (G6).
reasons.fg_state: Not possible while the pallet is "{{status}}".
reasons.v09: The FG label cannot print: {{missing}} unknown (V-09).
reasons.fg_changePending: A split or merge is already waiting for approval for this pallet.
reasons.fg_mergeCount: A merge takes two or more finished pallets.
reasons.fg_mergeJobCards: Pallets from different Job Cards are not merged.
reasons.fg_splitChildren: A split makes two or more pallets, each with boxes and kg above zero.
reasons.fg_splitSum: The new pallets must add up to {{boxes}} boxes and {{kg}} kg.
reasons.fg_versionOld: This pallet was created before split / merge was built and keeps its original workflow.
reasons.mb_explain: Explain the variance of {{variance}} kg: no approved tolerance covers it.
reasons.mb_wastePending: {{count}} waste record(s) of this Job Card are not weighed yet.
reasons.order_hasJobCards: Job Cards are planned for this order line.
reasons.order_notAccepted: Production is planned for an accepted order line only (now "{{status}}").
reasons.order_pastDate: The required date is in the past.
reasons.order_state: Not possible while the order line is "{{status}}".
reasons.requestReused: This form was already sent for a different request. Reload the page and try again.
reasons.v16: Waste is weighed only after the QC waste label (V-16).
reasons.v22: The pallets differ in crop, grade, customer or storage group (V-22).
reasons.waste_erpDuplicate: ERP reference {{ref}} is already on another waste record: check it.
reasons.waste_packagingLater: Packaging waste is counted by the warehouse (FR-WS-06), a later increment.
reasons.waste_phmLast: This record started before the current waste workflow: the PHM signs last.
reasons.waste_roleSigned: Role {{role}} has already signed this record.
reasons.waste_source: Source {{ref}} not found (a Job Card must be running, paused or completed).
reasons.waste_state: Not possible while the waste record is "{{status}}".

decisions.title: Open decisions & configuration
decisions.intro: The 41 open decisions from PH-OAS-SPEC-001 §13. A decision is recorded by its owner roles with a rationale; dependent steps stay blocked until then.
decisions.demoNote: Demo assumption on the demo farm only. It is not a management decision and a real farm cannot use it.
decisions.noOwner: No owner role named in the source.
decisions.approveHint: Each owner role signs once; the decision takes effect when all owners have signed.
decisions.recordHint: Only the decision owners can sign. Roles listed for activation get the waiting permission cells.

matrix.title: Permission matrix
matrix.intro: Spec §6.3 as the database enforces it. ● documented, ○ proposed, ? not yet verified. Proposed cells work only after the record-type owner approves them.
matrix.approveIntro: You own these record types. Approving makes the proposed cell usable on this farm.

config.title: Rule parameters & templates
config.intro: Values the rules use, each with its source. Pending values stay "Not Yet Verified" until their decision is made.

md.title: Packing-house master data
md.intro: Reference data loaded from the SOPs is Not Yet Verified until approved by a second person (SoD-07).
md.name: Name

exceptions.title: Exception board
exceptions.intro: Open exceptions from receiving to QC-1. Each links to its record.

rules.OD_05: Accepted without a set tolerance (QAM review)
rules.FR_MD_06: Weights on scales without confirmed calibration
rules.OD_06: QC-2 passed without a tolerance (for QA review)
rules.OD_11: Weighed waste waiting for OD-11 (sign-off route)
rules.MB_01: Job Card variance without an approved tolerance (last 7 days)

locations.title: Location board
locations.intro: Pallets in each location now, against its capacity, and the fridge storage group it holds (FR-ST-05, FR-ST-06).
locations.noCapacity: Capacity not recorded: Not Yet Verified

trace.title: Trace
trace.intro: Trace from a finished pallet, Job Card, incoming pallet, arrival or lot code.
trace.ref: FG pallet, Job Card, pallet, arrival or lot code
trace.scope: Back to the source and arrival; forward to Job Cards and finished pallets up to storage. Loads and customers come with dispatch (M3).
trace.jcKg: issued {{issued}} kg · consumed {{consumed}} kg · finished {{fg}} kg
trace.balancesNote: From recorded quantities only. Farm dispatch weights are not captured (OD-01, CP-02); weight loss is not deducted (OD-28).
trace.lotLine: accepted {{accepted}} · consumed {{consumed}} · in production {{prod}} · in stock {{stock}} · raw waste {{waste}} · in finished pallets {{fg}} kg
trace.arrivalLine: registered {{registered}} · accepted {{accepted}} · returned {{returned}} · rejected to waste {{waste}} · removed in regrade {{regrade}} · undecided {{undecided}} kg

jc.gradeNotice: The grade criteria (Premium / GR1 / GR2) are in the "company-approved grading standards", which have not been supplied (OD-05, OD-06). The grade is recorded as the plan states; it is not checked against a standard.
jc.onlyApproved: Only approved crops and lines are offered.
jc.route: This crop is routed to line(s) {{lines}} (Figure 4.2).
jc.specHint: Optional. Without one, QC-2 is recorded as "no tolerance set" (OD-06).
jc.issueHint: Only pallets released by QC-1 (V-05) of the same crop. Part of a pallet may be issued; the rest stays available (GEN-04).
jc.noReleased: No released {{crop}} pallets with kg left. QC-1 releases them in the "Released (QC-1)" stage.
jc.noJobCard: No planned, ready or running Job Card for this crop.
jc.packagingHint: The store keeper issues packaging to the line (SOP-PL). Packaging items and stock are not modelled yet: describe the item as issued.
jc.lineStartHint: Line-start check (G5): one of QC / Line Leader records it, the other confirms. The items are the product SOP's own.
jc.approveHint: Approving puts the Job Card in the plan: the store keeper is asked for packaging and the Line Leader for inputs.
jc.readyHint: Inputs and packaging are present. QC and the Line Leader are asked for the line-start check.
jc.confirmHint: Confirm the line-start check {{code}} recorded by {{by}}. You must be the other of QC / Line Leader.
jc.correctedHint: Describe what was corrected. The line-start check is then recorded again.
jc.qc2Notice: No grading standard or customer tolerance has been supplied (OD-05, OD-06): the result is QC's judgement and is listed for QA review.
jc.sampleHint: Sample drawn, e.g. 2.5 % of units (the SOP's working example)
jc.qc2FailHint: A fail sends the product back to the line for re-sorting. The Packing House Manager and Production Engineer get the task (T-10); no finished pallet until a later final pass.
jc.qc2Queue: Job Cards running now. QC records online inspections during the run and a final one before finished pallets are created (G6).
jc.completeHint: For every issued pallet enter the kg consumed; the rest is returned to storage and needs QC-1 release again before reuse.
jc.massBalanceLater: Mass balance against finished goods and waste (MB-01) and its tolerance (OD-28) come with the next increment (M2.2).
jc.awaitingConfirm: Recorded by {{by}}; second person to confirm
jc.noActions: No actions are available for you on this Job Card now.
jc.closeHint: Close the reconciled Job Card. Reopening waits on OD-15.

fg.createHint: Only after a QC-2 final pass (G6). The pallet number is issued by the system.
fg.gradeHint: A pallet not packed for an order carries a grade (V-10).
fg.compositionHint: Lots are attributed from the Job Card's inputs in proportion to the kg issued (GEN-05/06); the method is recorded.
fg.labelHint: The label prints only when every mandatory field is known (V-09). Each print is logged.
fg.fridgeHint: Finished-goods fridges only (F1–F4). The fridge group must match the crop (V-07).
fg.qcApproveHint: Your stamp starts the 24 h validity of the QC approval (SOP-GR, CP-06).
fg.compositionNote: Attributed from the Job Card's inputs; the method shows how certain the link is (GEN-05/06).
fg.noActions: No actions are available for you on this pallet now.

waste.createHint: Record waste from where it came from. QC labels it before it is weighed (V-16). Long-storage waste needs photos (SOP-WS).
waste.packagingLater: counted by the warehouse, later increment

sourceHint.job_card: Job Card code (running, paused or completed)

waste.referenceHint: Estimate only; the weight is taken after the QC label
waste.submitHint: Send this record to QC for the waste label.
waste.qcHint: Approve the waste label, or refuse it: the product goes back to the line with your reason.
waste.weighHint: Weigh after the QC label. The route to sign-off follows from the weight once OD-11 is decided.
waste.routeHint: Route the weighed record to its sign-off now that OD-11 is decided.
waste.topMgmtHint: Long-storage waste of {{kg}} kg: top management approval first (SOP-WS).
waste.signHint: Route: {{route}}. Signatures needed: {{roles}}. You cannot sign a record you created, labelled or weighed.
waste.erpHint: Enter the ERP reference of the waste posting. The ERP is not connected (OD-04): the reference is typed.
waste.disposeHint: Record that the waste has left the site.
waste.signoffNote: One signature per role and per person; the creator, QC labeller and weigher cannot sign (SoD-03).
waste.noActions: No action is open on this record.

mb.hint: MB-01 from the recorded quantities. Nothing is forced to balance.
mb.note: Issued − returned = consumed; consumed − finished − weighed waste = variance. A split or merged pallet is counted once.
mb.noTolerance: No mass-balance tolerance is approved (OD-28): any variance needs an explanation and is listed for review.
mb.explainHint: Required: the variance is not zero and no approved tolerance covers it.

split.hint: Enter the new pallets. Together they must hold the pallet's {{boxes}} boxes and {{kg}} kg. Nothing changes until the PHM approves.

merge.hint: Merge pallets in storage from the same Job Card, crop, grade and customer (V-22). The PHM approves.
merge.none: No other pallet in storage can be merged with this one.

fgChange.open: Split / merge requests waiting for the PHM
fgChange.decideHint: Approval closes the pallets and creates the new ones with the same QC stamp, location and composition. You cannot decide your own request.

order.notice: The customer is entered as Sales gives it: there is no customer master yet (FR-MD-04) and who owns customer specifications is OD-06. The order source and format are OD-37.
order.specHint: Reference of the customer specification, if any
order.packHint: As Sales states it (e.g. punnet size)
order.decideHint: Accept the line, or reject it with a reason (SOP-FC).
order.amendHint: An amendment returns an accepted line to "Pending acceptance".
order.cancelHint: A line with planned Job Cards cannot be cancelled.
order.shortageHint: Tell Sales and Logistics about a shortage. SOP-FC asks for it {{hours}} h before the required date.
order.planHint: The Job Card takes {{crop}} and {{grade}} from the order line. The PHM approves it as any Job Card.

plan.title: Daily production plan
plan.intro: Open order lines, Job Cards by line, raw stock (oldest first) and finished stock for the day. Plans are made by creating Job Cards, which the PHM approves.
plan.rawLine: released {{released}} kg · stored {{stored}} kg · {{n}} pallets · oldest {{age}} h
plan.rawNote: Stored pallets need QC-1 release before they are issued.

browserDb.title: Packing House Operations — demo
browserDb.what: This demo runs the system's own database (PostgreSQL) inside your browser: the same rules, role permissions, workflow steps and audit trail as the server version, with the demo farm only. Data stays on this device.
browserDb.kept: Your changes are kept in this browser until you reset the demo.
browserDb.notKept: This browser does not keep data here: changes are lost when the page reloads.
browserDb.confirmReset: Delete all changes on this device and start the demo again?
browserDb.failedTitle: The demo database could not start
browserDb.failedBody: This browser stopped the database engine from loading. Try reloading, or open the page in a current Safari, Chrome or Edge.

steps.download: Downloading the database engine (about 21 MB on the first visit)
